headline: AMBER: HRV 42 / RHR 51 day after Monza. Knee clear, quads and glutes sore. Rest today, Tue likely bike
summary: HRV 42 (7-day avg 57, 65-77 a week ago), RHR 51 (baseline 46), sleep 6.8h score 76. CTL 48.6, ATL 51.6, TSB -3. No illness signs. Likely cause: race plus a full day outside after it with little water, on 5.7h sleep. Left knee pain gone overnight, consistent with irritation from the slow low-cadence jog. Soreness is quads and glutes only, normal for a fast flat HM, peaks on day 2. Flight to Podgorica lands 22:45 tonight, so Tue sleep will be short.
flags: Today: rest. 2.5-3L water by bedtime plus electrolytes (1 tab or salted food), carb-heavy dinner before the flight, no alcohol on the plane.
Tue gate: knee test (10 single-leg squats left + stairs down) AND HRV. HRV under 60 or quads still sore = 50min hotel bike 120-135bpm, cadence 85-95. Expect the bike.
Wed: run 50min + strides only if HRV over 55 and soreness is down to stiffness. Quads/glutes only, so strides stay in if legs feel loose after 20min.
Sat +10% (2h15 to 2h30, load 110 to 120) now needs HRV over 62 by Thu, not just a clean knee.
Pattern to watch: HRV dips after every travel day this block (Bucharest 54-57, now 42). Hydration on travel days is a cheap fix.
